symbolDescription:
Configures PDF.js for every viewer instance. Call it once at startup, before the first viewer
mounts. Calls merge with previous configuration.

optionDescriptions.isEvalSupported: Forwarded to getDocument; kept false as defense in depth (CVE-2024-4367).
optionDescriptions.loader: Returns the pdfjs-dist module, e.g. () => import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs') for older browsers.
optionDescriptions.workerPort: A ready Worker running the PDF.js worker; takes precedence over workerSrc.
optionDescriptions.workerSrc: Worker script URL. A worker you set on GlobalWorkerOptions yourself is respected.
